method: source-based thematic synthesis; no new user study
decision: How should a cross-device Mobile Agent bind objects and intent, supervise execution, intervene, and resume tasks, with Fold as a focus executor?

title: 把要求绑到具体对象，才能减少返工
Bind instructions to objects to reduce rework
observation: WorkBuddy 原处双写、小艺圈选与伴随式入口提供对象带入路径；Codex 公开问题记录出现旧选区重复附带、发出后难回查。
WorkBuddy co-writing and Xiaoyi selection/context entry offer ways to bring objects into a request. Public Codex issues describe stale selections and difficulty inspecting what was sent.
interpretation: 机会是保留文档、选区和版本，减少改错范围；聊天入口的数量不能解释这类问题。
The opportunity is preserving document, selection and version so edits stay in scope; counting chat entry points does not explain this friction.
counter: 小修改可能直接手改更快。桌前已有选区入口时，手机还会增加拿取与传输。
Small edits may be faster manually. A phone adds handling and transfer when selection is already available on the PC.
action: 手机带着明确选区表达要求；执行端原位预览与核验，比较原生编辑与已有远程能力。
Carry explicit selection and intent on phone; preview and verify in place on the executor. Compare with native editing and existing remote capabilities.
confidence: 机制线索中等；频率与新布局收益低。
Moderate mechanism evidence; low confidence in frequency and layout benefit.

title: 表达之后还有精修，工具需要稳定
Expression is followed by refinement; tools need stability
observation: 语音长用与体验个案仍涉及技术词纠错、背景声音和发前校正；菜单研究与控制器个案提示位置记忆、已有快捷键会影响表现。

Long-use dictation and review cases include technical-term corrections, background sound and pre-send editing. Menu studies and controller cases point to spatial memory and existing shortcuts as performance factors.
interpretation: 离散要求适合语言；连续参数适合直接调节；结构修改与复杂检查仍需要原生大屏。
Language suits discrete intent; direct controls suit continuous parameters; structural edits and complex inspection still need the native large-screen editor.
counter: 动态菜单研究结果有条件，不能推出一切动态界面无效；实体旋钮手感也不能直接移植到玻璃上。
Dynamic-menu results are conditional, not a verdict against every adaptive interface. A glass control does not inherit a physical knob’s feel.
action: 固定高频动作和返回/停止位置，只推荐少量工具；比较熟练键鼠和本机触控。
Keep frequent actions and return/stop stable, suggest few tools, and compare with practiced keyboard/mouse and native touch.
confidence: 有论文与个案交叉线索；Fold 分区与副手收益仍低置信。
Research and cases provide converging clues; Fold zoning and secondary-hand gains remain low-confidence.

title: 只在需要人时介入，决定必须有对象
Intervene when a person is needed; decisions need a target
observation: Claudeq、F-Row 与 Micro 案例出现等待问题、任务状态和并行入口；Conn 作者记录误批准风险，也有 Micro 用户很少用批准键。
Claudeq, F-Row and Micro cases expose waiting questions, task state and parallel entry points. Conn documents accidental approval risk; some Micro users rarely use approval keys.
interpretation: 有价值的是找到正确阻塞并理解后果；状态、通知和决策承担不同职责。
Value lies in finding the right blocker and understanding consequences; state, notification and decision serve different roles.
counter: 单任务或低审批频率用户可能用不到独立面板。小屏和过期状态可能增加误判。
A separate panel may be unnecessary for single-task or infrequent-approval users. Small screens and stale state can increase mistakes.
action: Fold 下区承接复杂差异检查；离桌手机只处理信息足够的短请求，并直达原任务。
Review complex changes below on Fold; away from the desk, phone handling is limited to sufficiently explained short requests linked to the original task.
confidence: 实现与问题记录中等；普遍需求与留存低。
Moderate implementation/problem evidence; low confidence in general demand and retention.

title: 额外设备的价值，要扣除接续与维护成本
Deduct handoff and maintenance costs from device value
observation: 远程资料与公开问题涉及附件、任务送达和恢复；历史控制器案例同时有少换手的动机和换设备变慢的反例。
Remote materials and public issues cover attachment delivery, task receipt and recovery. Historical controllers show both reduced hand-switching motives and cases where changing devices slowed work.
interpretation: 手机的差异主要在离桌、现场采集或展开画布的副手输入；桌前本机分区应是直接对照。
Phone differentiation is mainly away-from-desk use, field capture or secondary-hand input with an unfolded canvas. Native Fold zoning is the immediate desk baseline.
counter: 相机联动、Remote 或一个好热键可能已经解决问题；配对、解锁、视线移动与维护会消耗收益。
Linked capture, Remote or a good hotkey may already solve the problem. Pairing, unlocking, gaze movement and upkeep consume gains.
action: 比较完整行为链，包括首次设置、失败恢复与再次使用；不以演示速度判断效率。
Compare the whole behaviour chain, including setup, failure recovery and repeat use; do not judge efficiency from demo pacing.
confidence: 代价机制线索中等；达到收益平衡的场景比例未知。
Moderate cost-mechanism clues; the share of scenarios that break even is unknown.
New scenario benefit is low-confidence; reach and frequency unknown

title: WPS：手机跟随讲者，控制同一次放映
WPS: the phone follows the presenter and controls the same session
天生会画：手机做副手工具，PC 画布持续编辑
GoPaint: phone tools for the other hand, continuous editing on PC
华为笔记：手机采现场材料，Agent 续入同一笔记
Huawei Notes: phone field capture continues into the same note
中望 CAD：手机说尺寸、调参数，Fold 锁定对象并预览
ZWCAD: specify and adjust dimensions on phone, lock and preview on Fold
剪映：手机定位切点，Fold 保留预览和时间线
Jianying: locate cuts on phone, retain preview and timeline on Fold
WorkBuddy：手机带选区提要求，PC 原位改稿与验收
WorkBuddy: scoped instructions on phone, in-place revision and review on PC
